heading: CFA-Focused Learning for Global Finance Careers

cards.title: CFA Scholarships for High-Achieving Students
texts: ATLAS students can apply for up to 3 CFA scholarships each year, with exam fee support of up to USD 1,000 for any level of the CFA Program.

cards.title: CFA Registration Fee Advantage
texts: As a CFA-affiliated institution, eligible students can access CFA Level I registration at a significantly reduced fee of approximately USD 600, making a globally respected certification more accessible.

cards.title: CFA-Aligned Curriculum for Global Relevance
texts: Learn finance through a curriculum designed to reflect global industry standards, with over 80% alignment to the CFA Program. This alignment reinforces strong academic rigour and ensures learning stays relevant to evolving financial markets.

cards.title: Access to the CFA Learning Ecosystem
texts: Students gain exposure to the CFA Learning Ecosystem and updated CFA curriculum resources, supporting deeper learning and strengthening pathways to global finance careers.

cards.title: A Distinct CFA Affiliation Advantage
texts: ATLAS is among a select group of institutions in Mumbai offering the CFA Institute University Affiliation Program (UAP) and is the only university in Maharashtra with this recognition at the undergraduate level.
